# Printing the case

The case is an original design, free on
[MakerWorld](https://makerworld.com/de/models/2713675-spoolmanscale#profileId-3005075).

| | |
|---|---|
| Plates | All parts fit on 3 plates, currently spread over 4 |
| Time | about 4 to 6 hours |
| Material | PLA or PETG for the body |
| Feet | TPU grips better; self-adhesive silicone feet do just as well |

If the display sits too tight, check the first layer for elephant's foot
before you reach for a knife.

Which screws you need and what for: [Assembly](assembly.md#screws). If
something does not fit, say so on [Discord](https://discord.gg/K3KmKnrWhP) or
[MakerWorld](https://makerworld.com/de/models/2713675-spoolmanscale#profileId-3005075).
